snippet.title: UFC 6 Official Gameplay Deep Dive
snippet.description:
Pre-order UFC® 6 Ultimate Edition to receive 7-day early access and the Iconic Moments Bundle: https://x.ea.com/89084 

Everyone’s fight looks different. Explore how in this UFC 6 deep dive.

Cutting-edge Markerless Capture and Sapien Technology make the fighters in UFC 6 look, move, strike, and react in true-to-life fashion. Master each fighter, discover their strengths, and test whether “styles make fights” or not. 

Real-Time Contact brings the impact to the Octagon with Frostbite™ powered ragdoll physics and damage reactions that hurt so good. Dish out the damage and enter Flow State, which engages an athlete's standout skills in punishing fashion. 

UFC 6 is built around fighter individuality, making every matchup feel different and every style worth discovering. Square up and fight your fight.

Follow for official news

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/easportsufc
